I took this from the project's own recipe, `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses this exact feature as its example. I haven't opened the source files, so line numbers come from the docs and may have drifted.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add a `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` type and an inn-cost constant, e.g. `INN_REST_COST`. The cost has to live in the Worker because the Worker owns the rules. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with a `POST /`. It validates the body and calls `getCharacter`. It rejects if `gold < cost` or HP is already full. Then it calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, which only accepts whitelisted fields). It returns `{ updatedCharacter }`. Optionally it also calls `askDM` for narration, `appendHistory` + `saveSession`, and inserts an `adventure_log` row, following `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` (~lines 41-48) | Add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)` and the import. No CORS change is needed unless there is a new origin. |
| `worker/src/services/*.ts` | Only if the logic is shared with another route, e.g. a `restAtInn` helper. Otherwise skip. |
| `worker/migrations/` | Nothing needed. `gold` and `hp` already exist. If you add a schema change, make it a new `000N_*.sql` and never edit `0001`. |

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface mirroring the Worker response. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `rest()` handler. It calls the API, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` so the sheet updates. It pushes a system or narrative entry, and handles an insufficient-gold error. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (N gold)" button next to the Inventory button (line ~9). Disable it when gold is too low, HP is full, or combat is active. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.css` | Style the button if needed. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy. |

## Docs to update in the same change
- Update the doc beside each changed file under `docs/code/...`, and add one for `rest.ts`. Link both ends, per `docs/AUTHORING.md` §3.
- Add the new doc to `code.md`, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- Update the PRD §9 API spec, and `docs/flows/` if you add a dedicated flow. Add an `AGENTS.md` routing row only if this counts as a new feature area.

## Things to watch
- **Combat state:** decide whether resting is blocked mid-combat, and enforce it in the Worker.
- **Session HP copy:** potion HP is only set locally and never saved (B-05). Check that `rest` doesn't leave a stale HP value in the KV session.
- **Shop bug:** B-02 breaks shop buying, but it doesn't affect this feature.
